title: Static Site Configuration
description: Configuration for theme, layout, content, and navigation

categories.description: Content taxonomy categories that structure the site's ontology. Each category (e.g., 'Technology', 'Culture') has an id, label, optional icon, and children (subcategories). Aim for balanced distribution: subcategories should contain roughly equal numbers of items to ensure even navigation weight. Keep categories generic and obvious for browsing; expert users can use tags or full-text search. Aim for more than 3 and less than 10 categories.

children.description: Content taxonomy subcategories. Aim for balanced distribution: subcategories should contain roughly equal numbers of items to ensure even navigation weight. Aim for more than 2 and less than 7 subcategories.

menu_links.description: Links for internal navigation. url field corresponds to internal urls (e.g '/about'). These pages must be created as extensions to the base.html template

landing.description: Homepage hero section with intro_title (headline), intro_text (subtext), and featured_count (number of featured items to display).

intro_title.description: Headline/intro title for the landing page hero section

intro_text.description: Subtext/intro description for the landing page hero section. Explain clearly the site's main purpose or value proposition

featured_count.description: Number of featured content items to display in the landing page

title.description: Header title displayed at the top of the page for all pages

subtitle.description: Header subtitle providing context or secondary information below the header title. Keep it brief to complement the main title.

copyright.description: Copyright notice text displayed in the site footer. Typically includes year and site name (e.g., '© 2024 SiteName')

text.description: Footer text. Another description of the web site. Should be really short

search_bar.description: Placeholder text for the site search input field (e.g., 'Search...'). Keep it neutral and task-oriented to guide users without biasing results.

default_image_alt.description: Alt text for the default placeholder image shown when content images are missing. Keep it generic (e.g., 'Image unavailable') to avoid implying broken functionality.

enabled.description: Whether the search feature is active on the site. Set to false to hide the search bar and disable search functionality entirely.
Whether dark mode is available on the site. Set to false to disable the dark mode toggle and always use light mode.
